The warmest everyday layer

A long-sleeve top in wool & silk is the classic Nordic base layer: thin enough to wear under a shirt or jumper, warm enough for winter. Turtlenecks and mock necks add warmth at the neck and look polished on their own.

Pair with matching leggings for a complete base layer, or add a cardigan or bolero on top.
